description:
Welcome to a full walkthrough of the Colorado here at Palm Harbor Homes of Abilene. 

If you're looking for a home that delivers style, functionality, and value, this floor plan deserves a serious look. In this video, we take you through the entire home, showcasing the exterior design, spacious living area, beautiful kitchen, comfortable bedrooms, and all the details that make the Colorado stand out!

Whether you're a first time buyer, looking to downsize, or simply searching for an affordable home without sacrificing home without sacrificing quality, the Colorado offers a lot of love!

Take a tour and see for yourself why this floor plan continues to attract attention.
☎️ (325)676-9700
📍 3301 Hickory St., Abilene, Tx
